profile_text.body:
C3.ai, Inc. is a for-profit public company headquartered in Redwood City, California, trading under ticker AI. SEC records list CIK 0001577526, and the company is also listed as C3.AI INC-A. The website captured for C3.ai, Inc. is airliquide.com, and its text describes Air Liquide rather than C3.ai. Air Liquide is described as a world leader in gases, technologies and services for industry and healthcare, serving 4.3 million customers and patients across 59 countries with approximately 65,000 employees.

The site also announces a research chair titled "Artificial intelligence for chemistry and through chemistry" involving Air Liquide, the École normale supérieure and its Foundation. No specific AI products are listed for C3.ai, Inc. in the available data. Available records show 281 California law exposure entries for the company, and no cases or MCP servers are listed.
